text:
elaine: FYI POC with BetaCorp demo just hit repeated 429s during a 5-min guided run. They're on trial budget 1,000,000 tokens. Can we triage? cc @raj @mike @sofia

mike: Can you paste the exact request IDs and route? Also last 50 lines of the gateway logs would help.

elaine: route is /v1/generate -> they do generation + rerank flow. Sample log snippet:
```
[1746004321.101] req=abcd1234 route=/v1/generate user=beta_inc tokens=320 status=429 reason=quota_exceeded
[1746004321.205] req=abcd1235 route=/v1/rerank user=beta_inc tokens=150 status=200
```
I can share full logs if needed.

raj: Hmm looks like they're getting charged twice: rerank is a separate subrequest. Our quota accounting should aggregate per-session but I see per-route caps are enabled for this tenant.

mike: Can you check tenant quota config? run:
```
curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN\" https://console.redwood.ai/internal/tenants/beta_inc/quotas
```
I suspect per-route cap set to 200 tokens/min for /v1/generate.

elaine: run output: `{"per_route":{"/v1/generate":200}, "monthly_tokens":1000000}`

sofia: BetaCorp is in the middle of a live demo, can we do a temporary bump while you fix root cause? they asked for +50k tokens today.

mike: We can do a soft bump from the admin console, but let's not mask the bug. Short term: increase per-route tokens to 1000 and disable per-route enforcement for the rerank subroute. I'll do the temp bump and leave notes.

deploy-bot: Incident opened INC-2026-598: POC quota 429s for beta_inc (assignee: mike).

raj: Root cause hypothesis: token-meter double-counts when a request spawns an internal rerank call. There's a header `X-Internal-Rerank` we added; token accounting treats each child call as independent and applies per-route cap separately. Need change in gateway: aggregate tokens by parent_request_id before quota check.

mike: I'll push a small fix to gateway: change 1) aggregate by `parent_id`, 2) use `X-Estimated-Token-Count` from model-backend not client `content_length`. Patch attached:
```
--- a/gateway/quota.go
+++ b/gateway/quota.go
@@
- charge := calcTokens(req)
- applyPerRouteCharge(req.route, charge)
+ charge := calcTokensForTree(req.parent_id)
+ applyPerRouteCharge(req.route, charge)
```
Will stage and roll to canary.

elaine: thanks. Also customer asked for billing clarity: can we provide a short explainer they can show their procurement? small blurb would help.

sofia: I'll draft a 2-line note: \"During POC we observed duplicate charge due to rerank subrequests. We've implemented a fix to aggregate charges by session; billing adjustments made for the demo window.\" Want it to be milder.

mike: timeline: temp bump done (1746004380). Patch merged to staging (PR #5678) at 1746004500. Canary deploy scheduled in 10m, full roll in 1hr if stable.

elaine: Customer notified. They accepted the temporary bump and asked to confirm refunds if overcharged.

raj: I'll run a query to compute overcharges and prepare an adjustment script:
```
SELECT parent_id, SUM(tokens) as charged_tokens, SUM(tokens) - SUM(actual_tokens) as overcharged
FROM token_events
WHERE tenant='beta_inc' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-02-20' and now()
GROUP BY parent_id
```
Will post results.

mike: Closing note: if you see more 429s after canary, add `?bypass_per_route=true` to demo URL as emergency workaround.

elaine: thanks team :tada: BetaCorp demo resumed.
